summary: Iteration 6 bug-fix verified end-to-end. Backend: 11 pytest tests passed, 1 skipped (chatbot slug not a module — expected), 0 failed. Voice module (slug='voice') now returns ALL text fields (answer, every key_points element, next_action, disclaimer) in the requested language script for Hindi (Devanagari), Tamil (U+0B80-U+0BFF), Telugu (U+0C00-U+0C7F), Bengali (U+0980-U+09FF), and Marathi (Devanagari) — programmatically verified via Unicode-block ratio checks. result.section_labels is a dict with keys {answer, key_points, next_action, disclaimer, read_aloud} each localized to the target script. English case returns natural English labels (no Devanagari). Multi-Language module (slug='multilang') for Hindi and Tamil returns translation, plain_language_summary, and every cultural_notes element in target script; key_terms_glossary elements have 'english' in English and 'translated'+'meaning' in target script; section_labels dict present with all 4 keys localized. Regressions: /api/module/{voice,multilang}/spec return correct fields; /api/templates/translate still preserves proper nouns (ABC Tech Pvt Ltd, XYZ Analytics LLP, 35000, 138) in Hindi. Frontend: Voice page /app/voice — switching the voice-lang dropdown to hi-IN/ta-IN/te-IN/bn-IN/mr-IN immediately localizes voice-submit-btn text (पूछें / கேளுங்கள் / అడగండి / জিজ্ঞাসা করুন / विचारा), the transcript placeholder, and section labels. Submitting a Hindi question renders the result panel with Hindi section headers taken from result.section_labels (उत्तर, मुख्य बिंदु, अगली कार्रवाई, सुनें, अस्वीकरण) — NO English 'Answer'/'Key points'/'Next action' anywhere. Multi-Language page /app/module/multilang with target_language=Hindi renders Hindi section headers (कानूनी अनुवाद, सरल भाषा में सारांश, मुख्य शब्दावली, सांस्कृतिक और कानूनी संदर्भ) instead of humanized English keys; the section_labels object is NOT rendered as a stray field.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2045 lines; splitting MODULE_SPECS and /api/module/* handlers into a dedicated modules router would improve maintainability (already noted in iteration 5).
MODULE_SPECS['voice'] and MODULE_SPECS['multilang'] system prompts now correctly demand full-language output + section_labels. Prompt is explicit that proper nouns may stay original script — good.
SmartModule ResultView correctly skips the 'section_labels' key from being rendered as a field and uses it as label overrides — verified in code and runtime.
VoiceAssistantPage UI_STRINGS map is compact and covers all 6 languages; result panel prefers result.section_labels with a graceful UI_STRINGS fallback.
test_credentials: Fresh users registered per-run: iter6+<ts>@nyaya.in / pass1234 (backend), uiv6+<ts>@nyaya.in and uimulti3+<ts>@nyaya.in (frontend).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice module page: /app/voice. Multi-Language module page: /app/module/multilang (SmartModule shell). Voice testids: voice-lang, voice-transcript, voice-submit-btn, voice-result, voice-play-btn. SmartModule testids: smart-form, smart-submit-btn, smart-result, smart-field-<key>. When waiting for smart-result, poll until inner HTML no longer contains 'thinking about' — the loading placeholder shares the same data-testid as the final result panel. To assert language correctness, use Unicode-block regexes: Devanagari [\u0900-\u097F], Tamil [\u0B80-\u0BFF], Telugu [\u0C00-\u0C7F], Bengali [\u0980-\u09FF] and require >=30% of alphabetic chars to belong to the script. LLM latency 5-15s per call — use 90-120s Playwright waits.
rca of the issue: Original bug: system prompts for voice/multilang asked for SOME fields in requested language while keeping OTHER fields (notably key_points and read-aloud labels) in English 'for reference', producing mixed-language output. Frontend also hardcoded English labels ('Answer','Key points','Next action') for the result panel regardless of language. Fix (already applied by main agent): (1) rewrote both system prompts to demand every field in the target language + a new 'section_labels' object with localized headers; (2) VoiceAssistantPage introduced UI_STRINGS for 6 languages and reads result.section_labels for headers; (3) SmartModule ResultView reads result.section_labels as label overrides and skips rendering it as a section. Verified via 12 pytest cases (5 non-English voice + English voice + 2 multilang + 4 regressions) and 2 UI flows.
